purpose: Grouped visual-value questions for the 34 remaining native token default-candidate gaps. Every proposed value and alias requires H3 decision before candidate changes.
provenancePolicy: Candidate identity does not establish upstream authorship. Member evidence distinguishes shadcn, Tailwind4.3.3, and Foundry-authored semantic mappings and extensions. Commit, file, sourceAddress, and SHA256 identify the exact evidence; redundant per-member upstream URLs and machine-local paths are omitted.

coverage.assets: Excluded; their policy and failures remain separately owned.
coverage.priorApprovedTokenFamilies: The 16 token families repaired before this sourceHead are outside this draft.

questions.question: Approve the published shadcn mappings shown for the live theme roles, retain accent.default → --primary, and complete absent hover/pressed/inverse roles with the exact current native light/dark extensions shown, labeled Foundry-authored? Native text.on-accent presently uses --primary-foreground; proposal follows the contract target --accent-foreground. Choose whether to approve that change or retain the existing on-accent value.

Approve categories 1–5 from shadcn --chart-1..5, and categories 6–8 as the exact existing Carbon-backed native extension values shown, with Foundry-authored semantic mapping and the original pinned Carbon scalar trail retained? These extra three categories have no published shadcn neutral counterparts.

Approve retaining all current native chart axis/label/grid/surface aliases or values and the current scrim light/dark alpha values as Foundry-authored extensions? The artifact includes alias targets and current resolved light/dark values.

Approve Tailwind4.3.3 neutral.50..950, blue.100..700 sequential colors, red-600/blue-600 diverging endpoints, identical endpoint/sequential values in dark mode, and the native border.base alias for diverging neutral as Foundry-authored semantic mapping? Each scalar and both modes appear in the artifact.
Approve the complete published Tailwind4.3.3 font-size and font-weight scales unchanged (13 sizes xs–9xl; 9 weights thin–black), attributed to Tailwind4.3.3?
Map code block from current 13px to the published Nova default text-sm=0.875rem (14px at base16), with the role alias attributed Foundry-authored? Nova small variant is text-xs=0.75rem.

Choose display role mapping: proposed m/l/xl/2xl → Tailwind 5xl/6xl/7xl/8xl = 48/60/72/96px at base16; or preserve current 44/56/72px and clamp(4.5rem,10vw,8rem) as Foundry-authored. Pinned shadcn evidence has no universal display scale.

Choose heading role mapping: proposed h0/h1/h2/h3/2xl → Tailwind 4xl/3xl/2xl/xl/6xl = 36/30/24/20/60px at base16; or preserve current 32/28/18/14px and clamp(3rem,6vw,5rem) as Foundry-authored. No pinned H1–H4 example source is present locally; do not attribute this role map to shadcn.

Choose icon sm/md/lg mapping: proposed size-4/5/6 = 16/20/24px at base16; or preserve 16/24/32px (Tailwind size-4/6/8) as Foundry-authored. Nova default button icon is size-4, xs size-3 and small size-3.5; it defines no universal sm/md/lg map. Retain the current native icon-stroke default 2 as Foundry-authored? The upstream stroke default is unmeasured in the available pinned evidence.
Approve explicit owner mapping of actual component defaults / theme primitives to native roles?
questions.recommended: control h-sm/md/lg=2/2.25/2.5rem; mark=1rem; switch h/w/thumb=18.4px/32px/1rem; sidebar=16rem; sidebar-rail=3rem; tooltip-delay=0ms; easing accelerate/decelerate=Tailwind in/out; transition enter/exit=Tailwind out/in; disabled=.5.
alternatives: Retain current authored values with Foundry-authored provenance.

questions.question: For roles without a published upstream counterpart, retain current native values and aliases as explicit Foundry-authored defaults?
questions.recommended: Retain behavior timings other than tooltip-delay; all brandmark sizes, density, gutter, shift distances; control row-h; focus outline and both focus shadows; duration scale; easing default/bounce; region aside/drawer/inspector bounds; state hover/pressed/stale; elevation none. Exact values, raw expressions, aliases and source hashes are in rows.
alternatives: Map duration.default to Tailwind default150ms and easing.default to Tailwind default cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); other scale members remain authored.
questions.reason: Numeric utility support does not establish authored semantic roles. Brandmark contract marks members moved to assets; this proposal changes token candidates only, not assets. Published Tailwind default transition primitive is150ms/ease-in-out; Vega focus ring is3px at ring50%, which differs from native2px outline and2px accent focus shadow.

questions.question: Approve native contract radius/shadow mappings, including the explicitly identified alias changes?
questions.recommended: elevation floating/lg, panel/md, raised/sm using exact TW4.3.3 shadows; none retained. radius default=.625rem shadcn base, subtle=.125rem Tailwind xs; retain authored sharp0px/pill999px constants. surface default/panel=.625rem and overlay=.875rem from shadcn active radius-lg/xl override.
alternatives: Retain elevation panel alias and existing dark overrides plus existing surface aliases/3px default, with Foundry-authored provenance.
Use Tailwind-only surface lg=.5rem/xl=.75rem instead of active shadcn overrides.
questions.aliasRule: Keep panel alias to surface-radius.default when selecting equal panel/default values; elevation panel alias must change for md versus lg; surface overlay alias to control-radius.default must change for xl versus md.
